original_test_intent: Validate PWR_MB_PSU1 and PWR_MB_PSU2 as the two PSU-related motherboard power channels against the approved electrical specification across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web evidence.
original_method: The power owner maps each exact record to PSU bay/serial, AC feed, DC output path and motherboard rail/load, defines whether values are per-supply input, output, allocated share or aggregate, and automation passively collects both channels under a recorded redundancy/load state.
manual_activity: The platform/power owner defines both channels' PSU and motherboard electrical paths, measurement boundary and redundancy/load-sharing expectations, supplies limits and reviews the resulting evidence.
required_inputs: Exact PWR_MB_PSU1 and PWR_MB_PSU2 names and installed PSU population
Per-index PSU bay/serial, AC feed, output connector and motherboard rail/load mapping
Definition of input power, DC output power, allocated share or aggregate measurement boundary
Whether the two channels may overlap or sum and approved correlation to PSU PMBus/platform totals
Units, scale, sign, aggregation window, refresh and unavailable/not-present semantics
Ranges and imbalance/tolerance rules by redundancy, feed, load and power state
SDR entity/description plus Sensor List/Web mapping and same-target revisions
Secret-safe collectors and independent power/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Resolve both exact members rather than querying a literal tilde expression
Bind each reading to PSU serial, feed and motherboard electrical path
Do not sum channels unless the owner proves they are non-overlapping measurement boundaries
Record fitted/absent, redundancy, load-sharing and health state passively
Do not power-control or hot-plug PSUs, alter load/threshold/BMC or clear logs
Stop on identity, redundancy, power-good, fault, freshness or completeness anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Verify unique source, two-name expansion and power measurement contract
Verify PSU/feed/motherboard path and same-target identity read-only
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List, both exact records and BMC Web
Compare value/state/freshness with passive PSU PMBus, redundancy, feed, load and SEL context
Perform no power service/control, induced load, mutation, retry or verdict
engineer_actions: Define measurement boundary, overlap/summation and load-sharing rules
Provide operating-state ranges, imbalance tolerances and absence semantics
Review both channels and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Resolve the two exact names and collect complete secret-safe IB/OOB SDR/Sensor List plus Web with passive PSU serial/feed/load/redundancy context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PSU1–PSU2, all source views and 3/3-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES TWO-CHANNEL POWER-PATH AND MEASUREMENT-BOUNDARY CONTRACT
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a two-row topology table binding sensor, PSU, feed, connector, motherboard rail/load and measurement boundary; evaluate each and any approved sum only under a captured redundancy/load state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Prevents two PSU-labelled readings from being treated as interchangeable or blindly added when they may expose different or overlapping telemetry boundaries.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: PSU internal PMBus readings are supporting evidence unless explicitly mapped to the MB_PSU channel boundary.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Redundant supplies can share load asymmetrically, and telemetry may be input-side versus output-side; applying a symmetric or additive rule without efficiency and boundary definitions can create a false failure or false pass.

project_override_considerations: Single-PSU or degraded-redundancy configurations require explicit expected presence and sharing rules. Differences from PMBus totals need approved efficiency, update-window and tolerance treatment.
expected_evidence: Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus both exact results
Passive PSU identity, PMBus, redundancy, feed, load, power-good/fault context and approved limits
BMC Web, same-target proof, passive SEL/platform logs, statuses and hashes

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently calls for two motherboard PSU power channels. The missing measurement boundary and topology are project inputs rather than contradictory source text.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The passive two-channel comparison is identifiable after the owner supplies the topology and measurement contract under ED-35/36.

review_improvement: Adds the electrical measurement boundary and overlap/summation rules needed to interpret two redundant-PSU power values safely.
independent_technical_reasoning: Two PSU-labelled motherboard power channels may measure AC input, converted DC output, branch delivery or allocated load. Redundant sharing and conversion loss mean equality or direct summation is not inherently valid; the sensing boundary and captured operating state must govern comparison.
